_about: DISPLAY space: the short summary of each project shown on the website. Run `node tools/build-projects.js` after a change: it rebuilds the cards on projects.html and the Key projects carousel on index.html. Everything else known about a project (context, details, open questions) lives in knowledge/projects/<id>.md, for the chatbot. The project pages (project-<id>.html) are still edited by hand.
